sources: White Night Nova. rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_sword_0014 and Json/BuffData buff_wpn_sword_0014_magic_up_ex (game 1.6); values SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_sword_0014 (level 9: spell_dmg_up 0.336, spell_dmg_up2 0.336, phy_spell_up 70, duration 15). Skills 1–2 (main attribute, Arts Intensity) and skill 3's Arts DMG + spell_dmg_up (cardAttributeModifier attributes 51–54) are on the stat panel.

passiveEventActions abilityEvent 102 (the wielder applies a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1 tags −1110095722 (Burning: Combustion) / 1466867135 (Conduct: Electrification) → CreateBuff buff_wpn_sword_0014_magic_up_ex on the wielder (attributes 51–54 Arts DMG + spell_dmg_up2, attribute 87 Arts Intensity + phy_spell_up, `duration`; stackingType 4: a new one replaces it). The two tags are statuses, not buff categories (buffTags.ts): a reaction trigger. Description: "After the wielder applies Combustion or Electrification, the wielder gains Arts DMG +{spell_dmg_up2} and Arts Intensity +{phy_spell_up} for {duration}s. Effects of the same name cannot stack."

beforeDamage: the status buff is added before the hit's damage (as Wulfgard's talent, batch 3); forced reactions count (they carry the tag). Rossi's ultimate Heat infliction on another element's infliction is her Combustion. toggleBuffs buff_wpn_passive_spirit_01: the template leftover (batch 1). Not in any log.
